Laser-flash apparatus Netzsch LFA 467 Hyperflash
LAser-flash method for measuring thermal diffusivity and thermal conductivity 
Netzsch LFA 467 Hyperflash provides:
measurements in temperature range from -100° C to 500° C,
measurements of specific heat capacity and thermal diffusivity/conductivity,
thermal characterization of conductive and insulating materials,
measurements with anisotropic samples, multi-layered samples, thin and thick samples, foils, liquids, pastes,
creating pressure for measurements with pressurized samples.
The principle of operation of the device is quite simple and is shown in the picture on the right. A short laser pulse is applied to the lower surface of the sample with parallel surfaces, during which only a thin layer of the sample is rapidly heated. Due to heat transfer, a heat wave travels through the sample to the upper surface, which is heated. Heat transfer as a function of time is detected with an infrared (IR) detector. Thermal diffusivity is obtained from the measurements. By using reference materials, we can also obtain information about the specific heat and thermal conductivity of the measured sample. 
Contact 
FAQ 
FAQ 
 Our company would like to cooperate with you. What is the procedure? 
Please contact us first using the form below and we will arrange an introduction meeting. During the introduction meeting, we will discuss your requirements and wishes and present the device in more detail. On this basis, we will prepare an offer for you. The measurements will start when all necessary components are delivered. After the measurements, we will arrange another meeting to review the results and agree on additional analyzes. In the end, you will receive the results in the form of a report. 
 According to the description, you can measure many different materials, but are there any limitations? 
In the laboratory, we have different sample holders for different types of materials. In that way, we can cover a wide variety of materials. Samples must be prepared in accordance with each sample holder, e.g., exact dimensions: thickness, diameter… 
 Can the samples be provided in the laboratory? 
The laboratory does not manufacture/modify samples. All the samples must be provided by the customer according to the sample holder standards. For more information, contact us using the form below. 
 When can we expect the results? 
The measurement method is rather fast. A simple measurement for one sample, without preliminary preparation, at a given temperature takes about 10 min – 60 min. The waiting time for results thus depends on the number of measurements at given temperatures and the number of samples. 
 What is the price? 
It is difficult to talk about the price in general, as it depends on several different parameters. For more information, please contact us using the form below. 
 How reliable are the results? 
The reliability of the results is heavily dependent on the input data. Crucial data is the density of the material and the sample shape dimensions. For more information, please contact us using the form below. 
Questions? 
Do not hesitate to contact us via e-mail or by telephone. You can also visit us at the Faculty of Mechanical Engineering in Ljubljana
